messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026.03.17 -> inference-api canary 10% traffic. https://deploys/redwood/rollouts/4532109876

olivia (sre): seeing canary pods CrashLoopBackOff, logs show OOMKilled + liveness failing on /healthz -> 503s from LB. :rotating_light:

mia (oncall): paging oncall — taking it. jumping in.

mia (oncall): @raj can you check the canary manifest? I think probe path changed in this build.

raj (eng): looking. `kubectl get deploy inference-api-canary -o yaml` shows livenessProbe.path: \"/internal/health\" but service expects \"/healthz\" — good catch, that would cause probe to fail.

olivia (sre): also HPA scaled to minReplicas: 0 in new template, so under pressure node drain + autoscaler allowed pods to drop to 0 during cutover.

support-ops: customers reporting 503s for requests routed to inference-api in eu-west-1. Incident form: https://incidents/redwood/4532109876

mia (oncall): impact: mid-late startup 503s, some live customers impacted. severity: P1 (customer-facing, degraded routing). We'll kill cutover and rollback.

raj (eng): suggest immediate mitigation: 1) flip feature flag `inference-api-new-encoder` OFF, 2) pause traffic in traffic-shift, 3) rollback canary to v2026.03.15.

mia (oncall): doing ff toggle now. `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/flags/inference-api-new-encoder -d '{"enabled":false}'` -> response 200.

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled by mia (oncall). Pausing traffic shift.

olivia (sre): patching deployment to fix probe path and HPA minReplicas. `kubectl patch deployment inference-api --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/livenessProbe/httpGet/path","value":"/healthz"}]'` -> done.

olivia (sre): `kubectl apply -f hpa-fix.yaml` with minReplicas:2

raj (eng): rolling rollback: `redwoodctl rollback inference-api --to v2026.03.15 --strategy immediate` -> in progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by raj (eng). Canary traffic set back to baseline.

support-ops: customer dashboard shows 503s dropping now.

mia (oncall): monitoring logs and LB metrics. Throttle cleared within ~90s. Confirming stability.

sam (product): any customer notices or tickets we should prep an update for?

support-ops: opening status page: "Degraded service for inference-api in EU region; mitigation in progress." posting update.

olivia (sre): after rollback pods stable, no crashloops. HPA steady at 3 pods. Memory usage normal.

mia (oncall): closing the feature flag kill-switch. leaving temporary postmortem notes. Assigning to raj and olivia to prepare postmortem and fix pipeline tests to catch probe/path drift.

raj (eng): will add linting to manifest CI to reject probe path mismatches and HPA minReplicas=0.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled in 6h to @sre-oncall. Incident ticket: 4532109876 created and linked.

mia (oncall): handoff noted. final status: rollback successful, customer impact mitigated, P1 -> downgraded to P2 for docs/action items.

support-ops: will follow up with customers who filed tickets.

mia (oncall): thanks all. closing thread once postmortem linked.
